purpose: Teach: 国名/軽自動車/預ける/最大手/料率/概論/役務/全日空

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、国名表記の規則を統一しろ
lines.en: Standardize our country-name notation rules across the company.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive tone. Sharp attack on the opening word. No preamble. Matter-of-fact delivery from someone accustomed to being obeyed. Brief eye contact that lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業用に軽自動車を増車する案を準備しました
lines.en: Understood. I've prepared a proposal to add light commercial vehicles to our sales fleet.
lines.style: Respectful, measured cadence. Flat affect — not obsequious, just professional. Slightly faster pace to show readiness. Lands firmly on the completion of the task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様の貴重品を預ける制度を厳格に運用しろ
lines.en: Implement stricter protocols for handling client valuables entrusted to us.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Slight pause before the key demand. Steady tempo. The tone of someone who knows this matters and expects compliance without needing to repeat it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界最大手との提携交渉を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently advancing partnership negotiations with the industry's leading firm.
lines.style: Steady, neutral reportage. Even pacing throughout. No inflection on 'currently' — just factual progress update. Voice stays level and dependable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、保険料率の見直しを進めろ
lines.en: Begin a review of our insurance rate structure.
lines.style: Economical command. Brief, controlled. Slight emphasis on the action word. No elaboration needed — the expectation is clear and direct.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人研修で経営概論を扱います
lines.en: Understood. We're incorporating business fundamentals into the new employee training program.
lines.style: Calm, informative tone. Consistent rhythm. Shows he's tracking both the directive and the broader organizational thinking behind it. Ends on a note of readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様向けの役務契約を整備しろ
lines.en: Prepare a service contract framework for our premium clients.
lines.style: Direct, controlled command. Crisp articulation. No softening. The voice of someone delegating work that matters and expects a solid deliverable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。全日空便での海外出張を計画しております
lines.en: Understood. We're arranging an overseas business trip via ANA.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly warmer than previous responses but still composed. Ends cleanly — the note of someone closing out the meeting efficiently and moving on.
